theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_level_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (t h : ℝ), LipschitzWith L f → 0 < h → h < 1 → ∃ g : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g ∧ (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ ≤ L / (h * (1 - h / 2))) ∧ (∀ x, fderiv ℝ g x ≠ 0 → t - h < f x ∧ f x < t) ∧ (∀ x, f x ≤ t - h → g x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, t ≤ f x → g x = 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
